Whether you're interested in book writing, article writing, content writing, story writing, or simply looking to add a new dimension to your writing using the power of AI, this app is the perfect tool.

Looking to write like your favorite writers, or even just looking to add a new dimension to your writing? Look no further than our revolutionary new writing app! With a database of over 1000 renowned writers to choose from, you can craft written works that sound like they were penned by literary legends. And for even greater flexibility, you can add your own book writer to the app's database, making the possibilities truly endless.

Using the app is incredibly easy. Simply input your text, select your desired book writer from the list, and let the app work its magic. Our expert algorithms analyze the selected book authors writing style, grammar, and tone, and apply them seamlessly to your text. The end result is a beautifully crafted piece of writing that reads as if it were written by the book writer themselves.

But that's not all. The app also allows you to convert your newly written text into a professional-looking PDF document that can be easily shared with others. This feature is especially useful for those looking to share their work with colleagues, clients, or even potential publishers. With just a few clicks, your work can be transformed into a stunning PDF that is sure to impress.

And for those who demand the ultimate in flexibility, the premium version of the app gives you unlimited access to the book writer database and unlimited conversions. This means you can write as much as you like, in any book writer's style, and share your work with anyone you choose.

Plus, with our newest feature, you can now copy text to GoodNotes with ease. Whether you're using GoodNotes for book writing, article writing, content writing, or story writing, our app seamlessly integrates with the popular note-taking app. Simply select your desired text and copy it to GoodNotes.

So why wait? Download our app today and start writing like the masters.

record.name: Notes Writer: PDF, Voice, AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Notes Writer brings handwriting, PDF annotation, rich text, Math Notebooks, voice recordings and AI writing tools into one workspace for iPad and iPhone. Capture a lecture, mark up a paper, plan a project or turn a rough draft into something ready to share.

WRITE AND MAKE IT YOURS
Create beautifully formatted notes with headings, lists, colors and highlights. Work with Word documents, RTF, Markdown and plain text. Open documents in tabs and move between your ideas and reference material without losing your place.

WRITE ON PDFs WITH APPLE PENCIL
Take handwritten notes, sketch in the margins and highlight what matters. Choose from pens, pencils, markers, fountain pens and watercolor tools. Use the eraser, lasso and ruler to refine your work. Add text, shapes, images, signatures and audio to PDF notes. Fill forms, organize pages and keep your reading and annotations together. Measure distances and areas on scaled drawings, and apply text redactions in supported PDFs.

GIVE YOUR WRITING AN AI ASSIST
Rewrite a passage, simplify difficult language, fix spelling and grammar, or adjust the tone. Summarize, translate and explore ideas with AI tools and chat. Keep control of what goes into your notes and documents.

CAPTURE VOICE, FIND THE WORDS
Record lectures, meetings and ideas while they are fresh. Play recordings back at your pace and generate transcripts to revisit the details. Add recordings to your PDF notes and whiteboards for more context.

THINK BEYOND THE PAGE
Build visual whiteboards with notes, images and recordings. Capture quick thoughts on sticky notes. Structure ideas in Outline Notes with nested branches, rich text and images. Collapse sections, rearrange your thinking, and import or export outlines in OPML format.

WORK THROUGH THE NUMBERS
Combine explanations and calculations in Math Notebooks. Explore formulas with the built-in calculation tools and run Python cells when you need more. Create charts, write LaTeX documents and preview the finished PDF alongside your source.

ORGANIZE YOUR STUDY AND RESEARCH
Bring your notes, readings and research together in Study Projects. Organize subjects, lectures and sources in the Binder, plan ideas on the Corkboard and keep reference material beside your notes. Study Projects give everything a place as your understanding grows.

TAKE BIG WRITING PROJECTS FURTHER
Organize writing projects into sections in the Binder, plan with a Corkboard and review your writing as a manuscript. Keep research beside your draft, save snapshots and compile your work into a finished document or ebook.

ORGANIZE, SCAN AND SHARE
Keep notes and documents in folders with recognizable covers. Scan paper documents, import files and find what you need with search. Export supported documents to formats including PDF, DOCX, RTF, HTML and EPUB. Use the Files app and supported cloud locations to bring your work with you.

LOOK AFTER YOUR WORK
Autosave, document recovery and automatic backups help protect your progress. Use app and folder passcodes for an extra layer of privacy. Continue opening your existing Notes Writer PDF notes and outlines as you move to the new workspace.

From your first handwritten idea to your final document, make room for the way you think.

record.offering: Book app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Chapterhouse is an AI book writer and novel writing studio for book-length work. Write a book with AI that holds one voice from the first chapter to the last: outline it, build the story bible, draft chapters with the AI story generator, run continuity and critique, paint a cover, and export to EPUB, PDF and print.

Not a chat window and not a blank document — a manuscript: structure, cast, continuity, and a voice that has to hold for 80,000 words.

NOTHING IT WRITES IS YOURS YET
Generated prose is never merged silently into your book. It arrives as a provisional layer in an editor's non-photo blue, with the sentence it would replace still visible and struck through. You read it in place, against your own words. It becomes part of the manuscript when you accept it, and not one moment earlier.

SET THE VOICE ONCE, HOLD IT FOR 80,000 WORDS
Style DNA fixes point of view, tense, register, prose density, pacing, and the things you never want it to do. It lives on the book and goes out with every request, so chapter nineteen sounds like chapter one.

TWELVE FORMS, TWELVE SETS OF CRAFT RULES
Novel, thriller, romance, fantasy or sci-fi, non-fiction, memoir, business, self-help, course or guide, cookbook, children's book, poetry or essays. A cookbook gets headnotes and recipes; a children's book gets spreads and read-aloud rhythm; non-fiction gets asked for evidence and flags its own unverified claims.

PLAN BEFORE YOU DRAFT
• Outline chapters with word targets, beats, and status
• A story bible of characters, places, and rules — extracted from the prose you have already written
• The signature stack: your book drawn as gatherings sewn to a spine, so you can see where the long chapters are, which are empty, and where drafting stalled

THEN WORK LIKE AN EDITOR
• Draft, continue, rewrite, tighten, expand, or change the register of any passage
• Continuity check reads a chapter against your bible and the chapters before it
• Critique names the actual problem instead of complimenting you
• Version history for every chapter, restorable
• Focus mode: the page, the word count, nothing else

COVERS, DRAWN NOT UPLOADED
Every cover is painted from a handful of settings, so it is always available, always sharp, and restyles instantly. No image search, no uploads, no licensing questions.

YOUR WORDS LEAVE THE APP
Export to EPUB, PDF, and print layout, plus Markdown, plain text, HTML, and a full project file. Plain-text and Markdown export are free forever. A manuscript you cannot get out of an app is being held hostage, and no paywall belongs between a writer and their own words.

BUILT FOR THE WRITING, NOT THE DEMO
Autosave with atomic writes, so a crash mid-save leaves your last draft intact. Dark chrome with a paper-white manuscript surface that stays light inside a dark app if that is what you want. Adjustable measure and type size. Four typefaces bundled, none fetched at runtime. Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

FREE
• 6,000 AI words a month
• 2 books, 5 chapters each
• Full outlining, story bible authoring, covers, editor, focus mode
• Markdown, plain text, HTML, and project-file export
Free is generous on structure and tight on generation on purpose: you can plan an entire book before you are asked for anything.

Chapterhouse PRO
• Unlimited AI words
• Unlimited books and chapters
• Continuity check, critique, and automatic bible extraction
• EPUB, PDF, and print export
• 50 versions per chapter

Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
